# RunningHub 工作流\n\n该插件把 RunningHub 的 Wo:
# RunningHub workflows

This plugin connects RunningHub Workflows / Apps to canvas workflow nodes. The API key, workflow parameters and field mappings are still stored and submitted securely by the host; the plugin itself never touches the key.

From the plugin settings you can open the full RunningHub configuration page to fetch workflows, edit field mappings and test requests.
# 媒体转换节点\n\n连接图片到转换节点后，可以在节点内选择灰度图、Canny:
# Media conversion node

After connecting an image to a conversion node you can choose grayscale, Canny edges, AI line art, depth map or pose skeleton inside the node. AI line art uses the local ControlNet Aux preprocessing model, the depth map uses the locally installed Depth Anything V2 Small model, and the pose skeleton runs the ControlNet Aux OpenPose human preprocessor; none of these load a Stable Diffusion repaint pipeline. Pose conversion only draws the human skeleton and skips with a notice when no person is detected. Video conversion and transparent matting models are still being validated and are clearly marked as unavailable for now.

The plugin only reads the current node's media input and saves the result back to the current canvas node's local asset storage.
